description: SVG chart component with progressive enhancement: semantic table → CSS chart → SVG chart.

attributes.name: data-config
attributes.description: Chart config overrides as JSON string

attributes.name: data-title
attributes.description: Chart title text; also the caption of the generated data table

attributes.name: data-label-x
attributes.description: X / category axis label; also the category column header of the generated data table

attributes.name: data-legend
attributes.description: Series legend with show/hide checkboxes. On by default; "false" hides it (bare or "true" keeps it on). Wins over data-config. Moves under the plot when the chart is 400px wide or less.

attributes.name: data-tooltip
attributes.description: Hover tooltips. On by default; "false" turns them off (bare or "true" keeps them on). Wins over data-config.

attributes.name: data-palette
attributes.description: Custom color palette as JSON array

attributes.name: data-chart
attributes.description: How to handle an authored source table: replace (default) visually hides it after the chart mounts but keeps it in the accessibility tree; enhance keeps it visible. Also readable from the table's own data-chart.

attributes.name: data-size
attributes.description: Render mode. sparkline strips all chrome (axes, ticks, gridlines, labels, title, legend, tooltip) for use as an inline trend chart sized by its container.

structure.description: Optional source table — data is extracted; the table stays the screen-reader (and print) version of the chart. Without one, chart-wc generates a table[data-chart-generated] from the data.

childAttributes.name: data-chart-series
childAttributes.description: Mark this column as a data series for chart extraction

childAttributes.name: data-chart-label
childAttributes.description: Mark this column as the label/category axis

childAttributes.name: data-chart-ignore
childAttributes.description: Exclude this column from chart data extraction

events.name: chart-wc:render
events.description: Fired after SVG chart renders successfully

events.name: chart-wc:error
events.description: Fired when no data is found or chart rendering fails (the data table is then left visible)

events.name: chart-wc:config-resolved
events.description: Fired before each render with the merged engine config (mutable, for last-minute tweaks)

events.name: chart-wc:upgraded
events.description: Fired once after the component upgrades; safe signal for the first .data assignment
